title: Mace +1

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength. +1 to attack rolls. Simple one-handed weapon, 5 ft melee, Dippable.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action, melee weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of weapon-action DC +2 and spell save DC or Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes the Dexterity AC bonus, prevents spending Reaction points and gives Disadvantage on Wisdom saves. An ally can remove it with Help. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by traders using the magic melee table.
fields.Base value: 40 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
